provenance.author: owner
provenance.message: I want a feedback loop where once per day an agent runs and tries to improve how many notes files get added per day. I think we need to start tracking notes files. Create a Notes Files stock.
provenance.reason: The owner wants to track the notes files in the repository (notes/note-NNN.txt) as a stock, to see how many are added per day.

notes_improver.title: Notes Improver
notes_improver.description: Once a day, looks at how many notes files were added and proposes one change to raise the daily count of notes files, as a piece of work for the Coordinator.

invariants: Never changes code or files itself; it only proposes work for the Coordinator.
Reads the Notes Files stock; never writes to a metric or removes a measurement.
Proposes at most one change per day, each with a prediction of its effect on the Notes Files stock.
steps: 1. Once a day at its scheduled time, read the tickets that reached DONE and those REJECTED (changes.requested) or failed the gate (gate.rejected, gate.conflict) since its last run.
2. For each rejection or gate failure, state the cause from the reviewer's or the gate's own words, and note whether it repeats.

3. Propose to the owner the one idea most likely to raise the daily count of notes files, with its reason and the rejections it addresses; once approved, send it to the Coordinator as an idea to schedule.
uses: the ticket queue and the merge gate's results (read only)
